verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs say it offers Batch APIs that accept up to 100 requests per call, with webhooks included. That is a first-party bulk-operation capability, but the evidence is a single headline claim. missing for 10: detailed batch endpoint documentation (which operations can be batched, error handling, partial-failure semantics), bulk operations beyond the 100-per-call cap, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Batch APIs — up to 100 requests per call, webhooks included
